description: 深棕肤色与浓密绿发对比鲜明，有力面容保留海洋祭司气质。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Illaoi is a powerful broad-shouldered adult woman with dark brown skin, thick green hair, strong facial features, and a sea-priestess identity. Preserve her substantial natural physique and green-gold ceremonial ornaments in a fully covering patterned tunic, layered armor, opaque lower garments, and sturdy footwear. Her massive golden many-faced idol rests securely on a stone plinth beside her, not raised or swung.
art_direction.scene: A balanced near-frontal full character, subtle contrapposto if anatomically appropriate, silhouette opening into a large quiet paper field. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: green, warm brown, sea blue, gold; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
